newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria emergency meeting may be at weekend.
newsitem.headline: Austria emergency meeting may be at weekend.

text.p: Austria's ruling Social Democrats said on Thursday they were prepared to hold an emergency coalition meeting this weekend to discuss the political impasse over the privatisation of Creditanstalt.

The conservative People's Party, junior partners in the coalition, on Wednesday called for the meeting to take place on January 13, but Social Democrat chief whip Peter Kostelka said his party favoured a weekend fixture.

"We've told them we're prepared to meet on either Saturday or Sunday, but have not yet received a reply," he told a news conference at the party's annual convention in this southern Austrian spa town.
A reply was expected within the next few hours, he added.

Kostelka said he was confident the two partners, feuding over who should buy the country's second-biggest bank, would resume constructive talks before a special session of parliament set for next Tuesday.
"I'm an eternal optimist -- even with gritted teeth we will manage to resume talks and settle the issue in good time," he said.
